gloss: to be fully equipped; to have everything in place

definitions.gloss: to be fully equipped; to be fully furnished; to have everything in place
definitions.explanation: To have all necessary equipment, facilities, or conditions thoroughly prepared and available. Often describes buildings, facilities, or systems that lack nothing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{完備|かんび}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{希望|きぼう}→希望：00221_kibou⟧⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I would like a room with air conditioning included.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{病院|びょういん}→病院：00577_byouin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最新|さいしん}→最新：04831_saishin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{医療|いりょう}→医療：01836_iryou⟧⟦{機器|きき}→機器：13180_kiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{完備|かんび}しており、⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦{治療|ちりょう}→治療：03503_chiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けられる→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: This hospital is fully equipped with the latest medical devices, so you can receive treatment with peace of mind.

notes:
Describes a state where everything needed is in place with nothing lacking. Very common in real estate listings and facility descriptions.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: fully equipped (facilities)
- ⟦エアコン→エアコン：05282_eakon⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: air conditioning included
- ⟦{冷暖房|れいだんぼう}→冷暖房：28048_reidanbou⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: heating and cooling included
- ⟦{防犯|ぼうはん}→防犯：08192_bouhan⟧⟦{設備|せつび}→設備：03301_setsubi⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: fully equipped with security systems
- ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦{完備|かんび}→完備：16692_kanbi⟧: parking available

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{整備|せいび}する→整備する：17849_seibisuru⟧: to maintain; to equip — focuses on the process of setting up or maintaining, not the completed state
- ⟦{備|そな}える→備える：02125_sonaeru⟧: to furnish; to equip — a general verb for providing or preparing
- ⟦{充実|じゅうじつ}→充実：04845_juujitsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be substantial; to be well-stocked — broader in meaning, not limited to equipment

REGISTER:
Slightly formal. Frequently appears in advertising, real estate listings, and facility descriptions.
